name: sansglu
description: Find gluten-free and celiac-friendly restaurants, bakeries and cafés, with cited labels and a map.

interface.longDescription:
Find gluten-free and celiac-friendly restaurants, bakeries and cafés in any city. Sansglu helps people with celiac (coeliac) disease and gluten sensitivity decide where to eat, at home or on a trip.

Ask where to eat gluten-free in a city or neighborhood, plan meals for a trip, or ask about one place by name. Sansglu shows the places on a map and in cards, each with one of three labels:

- Dedicated GF: the place says its kitchen is fully gluten-free, and Sansglu has a cited source for it.
- Celiac details: cited reports describe how the place handles celiac orders.
- GF options: cited reports or the menu show gluten-free options.

Each place links to its own website as the source. If Sansglu has no record of a place, it says so instead of guessing. Sansglu does not certify any restaurant, so always confirm gluten-free prep with staff.

Open any place in the Sansglu app to see its menu, community notes and the full map around it.
capabilities: Find gluten-free places by city or neighborhood
Check how one place handles gluten-free orders
defaultPrompt: Where can I eat gluten-free near me?

positive.prompt: Find celiac-safe restaurants in Williamsburg, Brooklyn
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a map and cards of up to 5 places in Williamsburg, each labeled Dedicated GF, Celiac details or GF options with a link to the place's own website. The answer does not call any place safe or verified.

positive.prompt: Is Nami Nori Williamsburg OK for celiacs?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Nami Nori Williamsburg with its Sansglu label and its source link (naminori.us), and reminds the user to confirm gluten-free prep with staff.

positive.description: Category filter for fully gluten-free places.
positive.prompt: Dedicated gluten free bakery in Austin
positive.expected_behavior: Shows places in Austin labeled Dedicated GF on a map and in cards.

positive.prompt: I'm celiac and in Lisbon for 4 days, where can I eat?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to 8 places in Lisbon on a map and in cards with their labels and source links.

positive.description: Food type in a named area.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows pizza places in Brooklyn with their labels, or says that none were found.

negative.description: General gluten question with no place to look up.
Recipe request; Sansglu has no recipes.
negative.prompt: Give me a gluten-free banana bread recipe

negative.description: Booking request; Sansglu does not book tables.
negative.prompt: Book a table at Nami Nori for 4 at 7pm

publication.release_notes: First release: find and check gluten-free places, with a map and cited labels.
